Job Title: AI/GenAI Engineer
No. of Positions: 1
Location: Ahmedabad / Pune / Indore (Work from Office)
Employment Type: Contractual 6 Months (extendable based on project), with right to hire
Experience: 5+ years of total development experience
Shift Timing: 02:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Start Date: Immediate



Role Overview

We are seeking an AI/GenAI Engineer to build LLM-driven and rule-based intelligence systems. The role combines prompt engineering, rule-engine design, and applied ML to deliver explainable, production-grade detection and summarization solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Build fuzzy matching capabilities using tokenization and edit-distance techniques.
Develop rule-based detection logic (e.g., ship-to logic, profile-change detection).
Generate "Why flagged" narrative explanations based on rule-engine outputs and ML features.
Implement signal summarization for surfaced insights.
Apply prompt engineering with appropriate guardrails for compliance and responsible AI.
Translate business needs into reliable, supportable technical solutions.



Must-Have Skills

Python – Expert
Azure Functions, Azure OpenAI Models, AI Search, Application Insights, LLM Guardrails & Responsible AI – Intermediate
LangGraph & LangChain, Agentic frameworks, Vector DBs – Intermediate
Designing rule engines, business rules, heuristics, and decision-making frameworks – Expert
Fuzzy matching, string similarity algorithms, edit distance, record-linkage methodologies – Expert
Machine learning concepts, feature engineering, model evaluation – Intermediate
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and clearly communicate status, risks, and tradeoffs.



Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with Databricks
MLflow, LangFuse, or any observability framework
Git-based workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews) and Agile/Scrum delivery



Additional Notes

Hands-on and accountable for delivering working, supportable solutions.
Clear communicator who can bridge business needs and technical implementation.
Quality-focused (testing, monitoring, documentation) with strong attention to reliability.
Calm under pressure when handling incidents and prioritizing production work.
